name: PyCon DE & PyData 2027
description: Python and applied-AI open source conference, masterclasses and sprints
note: Edition II tickets 790 EUR until 10 Feb 2027; CFP 4 Nov – 20 Dec 2026
details:
PyCon DE & PyData moves to Heidelberg in 2027, as "the leading conference for applied AI with open source". 19 April: masterclasses and Django Girls; 20-22 April: conference at the HCC with a social event and a start-up day on 21 April; 23-24 April: sprints, hackathons and a beginners' day.

Masterclass topics include Python backends and databases, pytest and Rust for Python developers. Early-Bird Edition I is over; Edition II (Blind Bird) costs 790 EUR until 10 Feb 2027, then Wise Bird and from 3 Mar 2027 Late Bird at higher prices. The organizers say PyCon DE sells out every year. The call for proposals runs 4 Nov – 20 Dec 2026 (talks 30/45 min, tutorials 90 min).
